title: Hearty Slovakian Lamb Pilaf
description: A traditional Slovakian dish featuring lamb, garlic, and dried mint, cooked to perfection in one pot. This recipe yields a garlicky, fluffy pilaf that is sure to become a favorite.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the dried mint, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the uncooked white rice and stir to coat the rice in the oil and mix with the lamb and spices.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and simmer for 20 minutes, until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
